content:
Context: 2. Registration and Emoluments

2. Emoluments.'Emoluments' for the purpose of determining the amount of mandatory contribution under the NPS includes basic pay as defined in FR 9 (21) (a) (i), NPA and DA.  
Re-employed retired Subscriber.Where pay on re-employment has been reduced by an amount not exceeding his monthly pension, the element of monthly pension by which his pay is reduced shall be included in emoluments.
